queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:nomenclature_nodes` ( `node_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL auto_increment, `parent_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `id_path` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', `node_type` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'M', `position` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `seo_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `timestamp` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`node_id`), KEY `parent_id` (`parent_id`), KEY `company_id` (`company_id`), KEY `status` (`status`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:nomenclature_node_descriptions` ( `node_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `lang_code` char(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `description` text, PRIMARY KEY (`node_id`, `lang_code`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
